sections.lever checks:
- Family and target: h14 (notes/hooks.md), list form. Two flattened tables of names and addresses; a listed firm on the same road as a trusted site. One member's road is spelled alike in both documents, the other's in two ways. Target medium (user 2026-10-13: Easy closed, Medium and Hard open). Quick test 2026-10-13: survived (user chat, no panel). No difficulty run yet; a quick-test survival sets no tier and says nothing about the medium solver.
- Dependency plan: D04 adds 32 entries (29 organisations) and prints each one's addresses; D03 Supplement No. 7 prints the sites of eleven validated end users. A firm qualifies when one of its addresses is on a road that also carries a D03 site. Two do: Sino IC Technology (Guoshoujing Road, D04 L891; Huahong Grace HFab 2, D03 L485) and Jicun (Feila Road, D04 L641; Lam's WGQ bonded warehouse on Fei La Road, D03 L374).
- Universe: every road name in D03's site addresses was searched in D04, in joined and spaced spellings (script and grep, 2026-10-13): Zhang Dong, Science Institute South, Taihua, Zuchongzhi, Di Sheng, Xi Qin, Guanggu, Xin Xi, Zhangdong, Hebei, Liangxi, Xinzhou, Huai He, Dayaowan, Jinghai Second, Ke Chuang Er, Shangfeng, Yihua, Fei La, Gaolang, Fangshan, Information, Bi Bo, Jingyuan, Yongde, Guanshan, Xing Chuang Si, Tangyan, North Xiaohe, Guoshoujing, Chuanqiao, Lot K7, Whitefield. Hits in D04: Guoshoujing (Sino IC, added), Feila (Jicun, added), Bi Bo (Hexin Xingtong, corrected). No other.
- Necessity: D03 is the only source of the validated end users' site addresses; D04 the only source of the added firms' addresses. Delete-and-guess: with D03 gone no road can be matched and a solver has no basis to pick two of 29 organisations; with D04 gone nothing identifies a firm. Street addresses on these lists are not recallable detail. D01, D02, D05 and D06 print no address of either kind.
- Selected-lever checks: which-items decoys named and failed. Hexin Xingtong (No. 912 Bi Bo Road; Lam Research Service (Shanghai) at 177 Bi Bo Road, D03 L429-430) is a corrected entry, not an added one. Beijing Tsingke Biotech (added) is on Jinghai 3rd Road and Jinghai 4th Road, Lam's Beijing warehouse on Jinghai Second Road: three different numbered roads. Wrong lists recomputed: identical strings only, one firm (Sino IC Technology); corrected entries not excluded, three firms (adds Hexin Xingtong); numbered roads merged, three firms (adds Beijing Tsingke).
- Targeted failure modes: Linking across documents / Wrong members in a list: the Feila / Fei La spelling; wrong answer Sino IC Technology alone. Which wrong answer the easier solver gave in the quick test is not known (no panel). To be matched to the wrong answers observed after the first difficulty run, before Submit. Considered and not declared: Hexin Xingtong as a third member (the question says "added"; predicted only).
- Calculation verification: not applicable (no arithmetic, no dates).
- Semantic/ID/overview probes: the question's words land on neither road. Searching D04 for "Guoshoujing" gives one hit (Sino IC); for "Fei La" none; for "Feila" one (Jicun). The bundle overview names neither firm's road. Shortest route: list D03's roads, search each in D04, then check each hit's entry type.
- Precision/readings: (1) Sino IC Technology alone, for a reader who holds that "Fei La Road" and "Feila Road" are not shown to be one road. For one road: same sound, house numbers 55 and 45, both in Shanghai, both in a free trade zone. Against: D03 says "Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone Pudong New Area", D04 "China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone", and no document says one contains the other. Still possible; the form's "One defensible answer" check will show whether its solvers split. (2) Sino IC Technology alone for another reason: Lam's site is a warehouse held "c/o HMG Supply Chain (Shanghai) Co., Ltd.", so not Lam's own premises. The question says "a site on ... list", and the address is printed as one of Lam Research Service's destinations. (3) Three firms with Hexin Xingtong: rejected by "added ... in September 2025". (4) "Premises" read as a head office only: each firm's row lists all its addresses without ranking them.
- Completeness: complete capture, no gaps. D03 and D04 read line by line on 2026-10-13, both tables in full.
- Style/set review: 33 words, one ask, a two-name list in a stated order. Shares h14 with sketch i02 (not written up). No other question on this task.
- Warnings answered: see the mechanical preflight in notes/handover-q01.md.
sections.question: Which firms that BIS added to the Entity List in September 2025 have premises on the same road as a site on BIS's October 2024 list of validated end users? List them alphabetically.
sections.reasoning:
Step 1. Source input (Doc 4, "Additions to the Entity List"): the September 2025 rule adds new entities and, separately, corrects existing entries. Sino IC Technology Co., Ltd. and Jicun Semiconductor Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. are both among the entities it adds under China.
Step 2. Source input (Doc 3, Supplement No. 7): the October 2024 list names each validated end user and prints the street address of every site it may receive items at.
Step 3. Source input (Doc 4, Entity List table, and Doc 3, Supplement No. 7): Sino IC Technology's address is on Guoshoujing Road in the Shanghai free trade zone. Shanghai Huahong Grace, a validated end user, has its HFab 2 site on Guoshoujing Road, Zhangjiang Hi-Tech Park, Shanghai. Both are on one road, so Sino IC Technology qualifies (second component).
Step 4. Source input (Doc 4, Entity List table, and Doc 3, Supplement No. 7): one of Jicun's addresses is on "Feila Road" in the China (Shanghai) Pilot Free Trade Zone. Lam Research Service, a validated end user, has a bonded warehouse site on "Fei La Road", Waigaoqiao Free Trade Zone, Shanghai. Neither document says so, but "Feila" and "Fei La" are two spellings of one road name in one city, so Jicun qualifies (first component).
Step 5. Decoy (Doc 4 and Doc 3): Hexin Xingtong Technology (Beijing) Co., Ltd. has an address on Bi Bo Road, Shanghai, the road of a Lam Research Service office. Doc 4 lists it among the entries it corrects, "first added to the Entity List on May 9, 2024", so it is not a firm added in September 2025 and is left out.
Step 6. Final answer (Doc 3 and Doc 4): no other road in Doc 3's site addresses appears among the added firms' addresses in Doc 4. In alphabetical order: Jicun Semiconductor Technology (Shanghai) Co., Ltd. and Sino IC Technology Co., Ltd.
sections.targeted failure modes:
### Failure mode 1
Trap: Linking across documents
How a careless solver fails: Wrong members in a list

Why these are traps: Linking across documents: Doc 4's table puts Jicun at "Feila Road"; Doc 3 prints Lam Research's bonded warehouse at "Fei La Road". Matching identical strings links only Guoshoujing Road and gives Sino IC Technology alone. Reading both spellings as one Shanghai road adds Jicun.
